{{Top|leg}}
'''Incinerator mines''' were explosive devices that when placed on the hull plates of [[Starship/Legends|starships]], erupted into very bright shockwaves.

Around [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], [[IG-88A/Legends|IG-88A]] used this type of [[Mine/Legends|mine]] to eliminate the ship containing his enemy [[Gurdun]] and the original computer core for the [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star II]].
